categories.main_business_segments: Anhui XDLK Microsystem Corporation Limited primarily focuses on the research, development, testing, and sales of high-performance silicon-based MEMS inertial sensors. Its main products include MEMS gyroscopes and MEMS accelerometers, which are core components for inertial navigation and measurement systems used in high-end industrial, unmanned systems, and high-reliability fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced MEMS microfabrication technology combined with ASIC chip design to produce integrated inertial sensors. It employs a fabless model, outsourcing wafer fabrication to specialized foundries and handling packaging and testing internally or through partners. The company has developed proprietary MEMS process schemes and maintains a closed-loop technology system covering chip design, MEMS process development, packaging, and testing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include high-end industrial sectors, surveying and mapping, petroleum exploration, commercial aerospace, intelligent driving, and high-reliability applications. The company has secured orders from automotive-grade clients and actively expands into emerging markets such as low-altitude economy and autonomous driving, serving both domestic and international clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters in Anhui Province and offices in Beijing. It also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Hebei Province. Its sales are concentrated in North China, South China, and East China regions, with growing international market penetration through its Hong Kong subsidiary.
categories.supply_chain_position: XDLK operates mainly in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless MEMS sensor design and development company. It relies on upstream wafer foundries for silicon wafer fabrication and downstream packaging and testing partners, while focusing on core chip design, MEMS process development, and final product testing and calibration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment, with 27.07% of revenue allocated to R&D in 2024. Strategic priorities include enhancing MEMS gyroscope and accelerometer performance, developing automotive-grade MEMS IMUs for L3+ autonomous driving, high-precision pressure sensors, and underwater navigation systems. It also focuses on miniaturization, integration, and multi-sensor fusion technologies to expand applications in industrial IoT, smart transportation, and aerospace.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales and buyout distribution of MEMS inertial sensors and related products. The company also earns income from technical services related to sensor integration and testing. Sales contracts are fulfilled upon product delivery and customer acceptance, with revenue recognized at the point of control transfer.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: XDLK positions itself as a leading domestic high-performance MEMS inertial sensor manufacturer, competing with international giants like Honeywell and ADI, which hold significant global market shares. While its product performance reaches international advanced levels, the company faces challenges in scale, brand influence, and manufacturing capacity compared to global leaders.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 404.5 million, a 27.57% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 222.17 million, up 34.33%. The company maintains a strong growth trajectory supported by expanding market penetration and increasing product adoption, with total assets reaching RMB 2.38 billion and equity of RMB 2.33 billion at year-end.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: XDLK offers high-performance MEMS inertial sensors with superior precision, stability, and environmental adaptability, comparable to mid-to-low precision laser and fiber optic gyroscopes but at lower cost and smaller size. Its proprietary MEMS chip designs and ASIC integration provide enhanced measurement accuracy and cost efficiency. The company’s products cater to demanding applications requiring high reliability and miniaturization, differentiating it from consumer-grade MEMS sensor providers.
